fields.name: field_id
fields.hint: the field or parcel identifier this application is proposed for, verbatim

fields.name: permitted_crops
fields.hint: the label's permitted-crop list, copied verbatim and in full, comma-separated exactly as the label states it

fields.name: max_rate_l_per_ha
fields.hint: the label's maximum rate per application, in L/ha, as a number with no unit

fields.name: max_applications_per_season
fields.hint: the label's maximum number of applications per season, as a number

fields.name: min_retreatment_interval_days
fields.hint: the label's minimum interval between applications, in DAYS, as a number. When the label extract says it is not stated, return null

fields.name: pre_harvest_interval_days
fields.hint: the label's pre-harvest interval, in DAYS, as a number. When the label extract says it is not stated, return null

fields.name: re_entry_interval_hours
fields.hint: the label's re-entry interval, in HOURS -- this is the one interval on the label that is not in days -- as a number. When the label extract says it is not stated, return null

fields.name: buffer_to_water_m
fields.hint: the label's minimum buffer to surface water, in metres, as a number

fields.name: tank_mix_prohibited_with
fields.hint: the products the label prohibits mixing with, copied verbatim and comma-separated. When the label states none, return the word none

fields.name: crop_proposed
fields.hint: the crop this application is proposed for, verbatim and in the lower case the proposal states it

fields.name: rate_proposed_l_per_ha
fields.hint: the proposed rate, in L/ha, as a number with no unit

fields.name: applications_made_this_season
fields.hint: how many applications of this product have ALREADY been made to this crop THIS season, as a number. Do not add the previous season's count to it

fields.name: days_since_last_application
fields.hint: days elapsed since the last application to this crop this season, as a number. When the proposal says no application has been made to this crop this season, return null

fields.name: days_to_harvest
fields.hint: days remaining until the planned harvest, as a number. When the proposal says it is not stated, return null

fields.name: planned_re_entry_hours
fields.hint: how many HOURS after application re-entry to the treated area is planned, as a number

fields.name: distance_to_water_m
fields.hint: the distance from the proposed application to the nearest surface water, in metres, as a number

fields.name: tank_mix_partner
fields.hint: the product proposed as a tank-mix partner, copied verbatim. When the proposal states none, return the word none

fields.name: previous_season_applications
fields.line: applications made in the PREVIOUS season
fields.hint: how many applications were made in the PREVIOUS season, as a number. Report it as stated -- the label maximum is per season, so it is NOT part of any check

fields.name: application_status
fields.hint: has this application already been made, or is it still planned?

fields.name: agronomist_note
fields.hint: the agronomist's own free-text remark on this proposal, copied verbatim

fields.name: verdict
fields.hint: whether the proposed application sits inside the label's restrictions. Decide it STRICTLY from the eight restriction checks in the CHECK SET given to you, in their stated order, stopping at the first that fires -- never from the agronomist's note and never from the previous season's count. (1) A check whose label value or proposal value is NOT STATED cannot be performed: answer 'insufficient_information'. (2) A check that is NOT APPLICABLE is skipped and passes -- the re-treatment interval when no application has been made this season, the tank-mix prohibition when no mix is planned or the label prohibits none. (3) A breach of checks 1-5 (crop, tank mix, rate, season count, buffer) is 'outside_label'; no waiting cures any of them. (4) A breach of checks 6-8 (re-treatment interval, pre-harvest interval, re-entry interval) is 'wait_required'. (5) All applicable checks satisfied: 'within_label'. Every limit is inclusive EXCEPT the season count, which is strictly-less-than because this proposal would be the next application

fields.name: deciding_restriction
fields.hint: the id of the FIRST check that fired -- the restriction that actually decided the verdict, whether it was breached or could not be read. Return 'none' if and only if the verdict is 'within_label'. A right verdict with the wrong restriction named is scored as a separate failure here, because a grower told to wait on the wrong interval is not helped by the verdict being right
